definitions.explanation: Chicken meat that has been finely chopped or passed through a grinder. A common ingredient in Japanese cooking, especially for meatballs, dumplings, and simmered dishes.

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つくね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make tsukune (chicken meatballs) with ground chicken.

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}→豚ひき肉：23445_butahikiniku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦あっさり→あっさり：05650_assari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ground chicken is lighter in flavor than ground pork.

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧、⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧にした。
examples.english: I mixed ground chicken with ginger and soy sauce to use as dumpling filling.

notes:
A compound of {鶏|とり} (chicken), ひき (ground/minced, from ⟦{挽|ひ}く→挽く：12794_hiku⟧ 'to grind'), and ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat). Also written as {鶏挽肉|とりひきにく} or {鶏挽|とりひ}き{肉|にく}, though the mixed kana-kanji spelling is most common on packaging.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦そぼろ→そぼろ：10383_soboro⟧: crumbled seasoned chicken (for rice bowls)
- {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つく⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: chicken meatballs
- {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧: chicken hamburger patty
- {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦グラム→グラム：01354_guramu⟧: 100 grams of ground chicken

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}→豚ひき肉：23445_butahikiniku⟧: ground pork — fattier, used in ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧ and ⟦{麻婆豆腐|まーぼーどうふ}→麻婆豆腐：20258_maaboodoufu⟧
- ⟦{牛|ぎゅう}ひき{肉|にく}→牛ひき肉：23362_gyuuhikiniku⟧: ground beef — used for hamburgers and meat sauce
- {合|あい}いびき{肉|にく}: ground meat blend (usually pork and beef)
- ⟦ひき{肉|にく}→ひき肉：17241_hikiniku⟧: ground meat — the general term

USAGE:
{鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく} is considered the healthiest of the common ground meats due to its low fat content. It is a staple ingredient for {鶏|とり}そぼろ{丼|どん} (chicken soboro rice bowl), a popular lunch item.
